title: Preserve canonical semantic snapshot across Staging role replay preparation

phases.objective: Preserve the canonical semantic snapshot artifact across role-aware Staging schema replay preparation so the governed full local Staging recovery can hand the exact manifest-referenced snapshot to the fail-closed legacy importer.

e2e_journeys.actor: Local Windows Docker Staging recovery operator
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: autopilot-portable-staging/Clone-StagingDatabases.ps1 -Apply after governed full local Staging recovery has produced an exact-SHA schema bundle
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Role-aware replay preparation carries the exact canonical semantic snapshot into the prepared replay directory, verifies its SHA-256 before legacy import handoff, and leaves Production/provider authority unchanged.
steps: Validate the exact source bundle and role-aware replay plan against the authorized commit.
Prepare the three role schema bundles in the temporary replay directory.
Read the canonical semantic snapshot reference from the bundle manifest and require the expected contract, safe file name, source presence, exact SHA-256, and valid gzip payload.
Copy the semantic snapshot bytes unchanged into the prepared replay directory and expose its prepared path and SHA in replay evidence.
Require the PowerShell wrapper to read back the prepared semantic snapshot path and exact manifest SHA before invoking the legacy importer.
Run the Staging database recovery contract regression and environment-impact closure against the exact PR diff.
assertions: The prepared replay directory contains the canonical semantic snapshot referenced by the prepared manifest.
The prepared semantic snapshot SHA-256 exactly equals the original bundle manifest SHA-256.
The semantic snapshot is not regenerated, transformed, or weakened during role-aware preparation.
Missing, malformed, checksum-mismatched, or non-gzip semantic snapshot input fails closed before database replay.
The existing zero-object and role-aware replay guards remain unchanged.
Only Staging is declared as an affected environment and live Staging certification remains required.
Production mutation, provider mutation, Hostinger mutation, Cloudflare mutation, credential payload access, and Production deployment remain forbidden by this declaration.

phases.objective: This Staging-only replay handoff repair grants no Production deployment, provider mutation, Hostinger mutation, Cloudflare mutation, credential authority, or production_live authority.
blockers: Production remains outside this pull request and requires a separate governed promotion with independent evidence.
No Production, provider, Hostinger, Cloudflare, migration Apply, grant Apply, or production database action is authorized by this declaration.
